SELECT CUSTCD ,CUSTNAME ,OWNER ,TAXNAME ,SANO ,TELNO ,HANDNO ,JANAMT ,POSITION ,SANAME ,POSITIONCD ,SALEPER ,MCGRADE ,GUBUN ,LASTKJSK ,MIMC ,SABUN ,get_date_fmt(PRDATETIME) PRDATE FROM CUST_MST WHERE 1 = 1 AND GROUPCD = #{USER.GROUPCD} AND COMCD = #{USER.COMCD}
AND CHK = 'Y'
AND CHK = 'N'
AND CUSTNAME LIKE '%' + #{frmCUSTNAME} + '%'
ORDER BY GROUPCD ASC,COMCD ASC,SANAME,CUSTNAME
